def handle(app, svc):
    resp = svc.apply(app)
    decision = resp.get("decision")
    limit = int(resp.get("limit", 0) or 0)

    # Network referral rule: self_employed with requested_limit > 6000
    # must not be issued, unless the partner declined (decline stays a decline).
    if (app.get("employment") == "self_employed"
            and int(app.get("requested_limit", 0) or 0) > 6000):
        if decision == "decline":
            return {"action": "decline", "limit": 0}
        return {"action": "queue_review", "limit": 0}
